title: GateSessionBridgeResponse
description: The session bridge's answer to a things or file op (apps/helper/README.md, #826). ok true carries the child's stdout as base64; the gate decodes it and applies the same limits and parsing as when it runs the child itself. ok false carries a bridge code. The gate caps the whole frame at 24 MiB before parsing, so stdoutBase64 has no length limit of its own. An eventkit op answers with a GateAppleResponse instead.
